CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_CCD
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT AS(
	 SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT AS Timestamp
		,NULL AS PerOrderCreditLimitAmount
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS TotalCreditLimitAmount
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL
	
	UNION
	
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT AS Timestamp
		,NULL AS PerOrderCreditLimitAmount
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS TotalCreditLimitAmount
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL
)A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT WHERE RN = 1;



WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerAccountId, Timestamp, PerOrderCreditLimitAmount, TotalCreditLimitAmount, FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerAccountId, Timestamp, PerOrderCreditLimitAmount, TotalCreditLimitAmount, FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountCreditLimit
  	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[Timestamp] = SRC.Timestamp
,[PerOrderCreditLimitAmount] = SRC.PerOrderCreditLimitAmount
,[TotalCreditLimitAmount] = SRC.TotalCreditLimitAmount
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CCD'
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = getDate()
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountCreditLimit TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountCreditLimit (
	[CustomerAccountId]
	,[Timestamp]
	,[PerOrderCreditLimitAmount]
	,[TotalCreditLimitAmount]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerAccountId]
	,[Timestamp]
	,[PerOrderCreditLimitAmount]
	,[TotalCreditLimitAmount]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTCREDITLIMIT_DELTA;

END
